div.div:
valid <-> checked_in (authorized reversal); valid/checked_in -> refund_pending -> refunded;
valid/checked_in -> cancelled on allowed cancellation
GUARD: No return from refund_pending/refunded/cancelled to valid. Checked-in voluntary
refund needs reversal/review.
TRANSACTION: TX-10/11/12/13/14/15

quarantined until succeeded.
